blocks.text: The Zscaler and GitLab Deployment Guide provides instructions on integrating Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) with the GitLab platform.

Gitlab is a service that provides remote access to Git repositories. In addition to hosting your code, the services provide additional features designed to help manage the software development lifecycle.

ZIA provides security for GitLab SaaS platform through access control, identity control, SaaS Security Posture Management, a SaaS Security API to scan the attachments for malicious content, and data loss protection (DLP). ZIA also provides complete security for clients whether they are in the corporate office or their home office.
This guide covers the following ZIA features for GitLab security:

blocks.item: SaaS Security Data Loss Protection and Malware Detection
Zscaler Posture Control GitLab Infrastructure as Code Scanning
